title: World Football Governance: Financial Fair Play (PSR), Transfer Windows & Multi-Club Ownership
workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance
description: High-register executive sports management module examining Profitability and Sustainability Rules (PSR), amortized player transfer contracts, UEFA financial sustainability regulations, and multi-club ownership models.
learning_objectives: Master sports law and football finance terminology (amortization, allowable losses, multi-club synergism, capital expenditure, CAS appeals)
Deploy sophisticated modal verbs of necessity, treaty subjunctive, and formal counter-argumentation in sports governance disputes
Eliminate Czech interference in financial audits, contractual arbitration, and compliance presentations

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ a Premier League club exceed the statutory £105 million three-year allowable loss threshold without triggering immediate sporting sanctions.

explanations.correct: Negative inversion after 'Under no circumstances' places modal 'may' immediately before subject 'a Premier League club'.
explanations.wrong_B: Uninverted order 'a club may' is ungrammatical after restrictive negative opening.
explanations.wrong_C: 'can a club to' introduces an invalid 'to' after modal 'can'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'might a club' expresses weak tentative possibility rather than normative regulatory prohibition.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po záporné vazbě 'Under no circumstances' (za žádných okolností) dochází k povinné inverzi: 'Under no circumstances may a club exceed...'.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: The independent regulatory commission insisted that the sanctioned club _____ its audited player amortization schedules without redaction.

explanations.correct: Subjunctive mood after verbs of legal insistence ('insisted that the club submit') requires the base form of the verb.
explanations.wrong_B: Third-person singular 'submits' represents informal indicative mood.
explanations.wrong_C: Past tense 'submitted' denotes a factual past reporting rather than a legal directive.
explanations.wrong_D: 'will submit' violates formal legal subjunctive syntax.

questions.cz_learning_point: Ve formálních právních nařízeních po slovesech jako 'insist / demand / require that' se používá konjunktiv (základní tvar slovesa): 'insisted that the club submit'.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: UEFA Club Financial Control Body statutes dictate that all licensed clubs _____ maintain a player wage-to-turnover ratio beneath 70 percent.

explanations.correct: Deontic legal modal 'shall' establishes mandatory contractual and regulatory obligation in governance charters.
explanations.wrong_B: 'could' denotes mere past or conditional ability.
explanations.wrong_D: 'would' expresses conditional willingness rather than statutory law.

questions.cz_learning_point: V oficiálních statutech UEFA a mezinárodním sportovním právu vyjadřuje závaznou právní povinnost sloveso 'shall' (musí / zavazuje se).
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: Preliminary forensic accounting disclosures indicate that the alleged sponsorship revenue _____ inflated above fair market value.

explanations.correct: Epistemic modal hedge 'may plausibly have been' precisely balances authorial neutrality with investigative suspicion.
explanations.wrong_B: 'must to have been' is ungrammatical syntax.
explanations.wrong_C: 'should of been' is colloquial and grammatically incorrect.
explanations.wrong_D: 'could have being' is ungrammatical participle stacking.

questions.cz_learning_point: V oficiálních forenzních zprávách vyjadřuje obezřetný odhad vazba 'may plausibly have been' (je pravděpodobné, že bylo uměle navýšeno).
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: It _____ by the arbitration tribunal that the multi-club network had engaged in unapproved intra-group transfer subsidization.

explanations.correct: Passive reporting construction 'It was definitively ruled that...' reflects formal jurisprudence and institutional authority.
explanations.wrong_B: Active voice 'definitively ruled' lacks a valid subject when preceding nominal clause.
explanations.wrong_D: Lacks the passive auxiliary required for impersonal judicial pronouncements.

questions.cz_learning_point: Formální právní výrok tribunálu používá neosobní trpný rod: 'It was definitively ruled that...' (Bylo závazně rozhodnuto, že...).
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: Should the club's board of directors _____ to appeal the ten-point deduction, the case will escalate directly to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS).

explanations.correct: Conditional inversion with 'Should' takes the bare infinitive ('Should the board decide...').
explanations.wrong_C: 'will decide' is ungrammatical in conditional inversion.
explanations.wrong_D: Third-person singular 'decides' violates the modal inversion syntax.

questions.cz_learning_point: Podmínková inverze se spojkou 'Should' vyžaduje infinitiv: 'Should the board decide...' (= If the board decides...).
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: The rapid proliferation of multi-club ownership models has necessitated the introduction of stringent _____ firewalls.

explanations.correct: Compound technical nominal pre-modifier 'cross-governance corporate' correctly qualifies 'firewalls'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'cross-governing of' cannot act as a direct pre-modifier with 'firewalls'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Složený přívlastek 'cross-governance corporate firewalls' označuje korporátní oddělení řízení mezi sesterskými kluby.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: Under relentless cross-examination, the sporting director conceded that player amortization periods had been extended _____ circumvent annual loss caps.

explanations.correct: Purpose connector 'in order to' followed by bare infinitive 'circumvent' formalizes deliberate strategic intention.
explanations.wrong_B: 'so that to' is ungrammatical; 'so that' requires a subject and modal verb.
explanations.wrong_C: 'for to' is archaic and non-standard English.
explanations.wrong_D: 'with an aim of to' is a malformed prepositional construction.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová vazba s infinitivem se formálně vyjadřuje pomocí 'in order to + sloveso': 'in order to circumvent' (za účelem obejití limitů).
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: The bilateral agreement between the league and the national association establishes clear parameters, _____ safeguarding competitive integrity.

explanations.correct: Conjunctive adverb 'thereby' followed by participle 'safeguarding' concisely denotes resultative consequence.
explanations.wrong_B: 'whereby' means 'by which' and introduces a relative clause.
explanations.wrong_C: 'hereby' means 'by this legal document' and is used in present declarations.
explanations.wrong_D: 'therewith' means 'with that' and is archaic in modern sports regulation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Příslovce 'thereby + tvar na -ing' znamená 'čímž / tímto způsobem': 'thereby safeguarding competitive integrity'.
questions.workplace_track: World Sports: International Football Governance & Finance

questions.prompt: Central to the arbitration panel's ruling _____ the finding that third-party equity injections had breached arm's length valuation principles.

explanations.correct: Stylistic fronting with adjective phrase 'Central to the ruling...' inverts with singular subject 'the finding', taking singular verb 'was'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'were' is plural, whereas the true subject 'the finding' is singular.
explanations.wrong_C: 'have been' fails subject-verb number agreement with singular 'finding'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'are being' creates an awkward progressive passive tense.

questions.cz_learning_point: Při stylistické inverzi ('Central to the ruling was the finding...') se sloveso 'was' shoduje s pravým podmětem 'the finding', který je v jednotném čísle.
